input.overview: For {duration}, io-shop's pages were slow to respond for some shoppers. More requests than usual reached the shop and used up the fixed amount of computing power its servers have, so requests had to wait their turn. The shop's account page likely does much more work per request than it needs to, which made the servers hit that limit sooner. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, because no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus added more servers to io-shop, confirmed that this worked and left the extra capacity in place. Automatic sync is still switched off. Argus also proposed a fix to the underlying problem, but it is only a draft and has not been put into use.
